card.name: Linking words after inhibitor terms
card.fires_on: The word just after "inhibitor" or "inhibitors" (usually "of" or "the"), or the middle of "inhibiting" and "inhibit", when a drug interaction names an enzyme or a reuptake target.

modes.label: "of" after inhibitor
modes.description: The word "of" right after inhibitor(s), before an enzyme such as CYP3A4 or CYP2D6.

modes.label: Inside inhibiting/inhibit
modes.description: Partway through the word inhibiting or inhibit, before the thing being blocked.

modes.label: "the" after inhibiting
modes.description: The word "the" after inhibiting, before reuptake.
modes.example: drugs inhibiting<< the>> reuptake of norepineph

card.writes: It adds little that is clear; the promoted words are mixed and unrelated, though some hint at mechanism or competition.
card.plain: It fires on the small word or word part that follows "inhibitor" or "inhibiting", right before the enzyme or target is named.
